snippet.title: Allemand avec Rayman - Opening
snippet.description:
Opening to German with Rayman, in all its crusty shovelware glory, bc for some reason it's not on YouTube yet? I've been meaning to record this for a while but just haven't for some reason. Anyways stan cousin Hans


Would open Spanish with Rayman and record that too, but alas, that won't even open with audio in DOSBox. I need a better rip first
